versions.content: The standardized common published parameters as required by SRS_BSW_00402 in the General Requirements on Basic Software Modules [REF] shall be published within the header file of this module and need to be provided in the BSW Module Description. The according module abbreviation can be found in the List of Basic Software Modules [REF].
